annotations.title: Nudge owners about items raised to you

description: As an Owner or Admin, remind the owners of items raised to you (from my_attention) in your name, as Home's Nudge does. Each owner is notified by email and Slack, and the items leave admins' lists for three days. Pass group:raised to nudge everyone in the raised group. Requires write permission and acts as the API key creator.
name: nudge_attention_owners
title: Nudge owners about items raised to you
